relevant_laws.quote: shall not follow any fire apparatus traveling in response to a fire alarm closer than 500 feet or driving to or park such vehicle within 500 feet of fire apparatus which stopped in answer to a fire alarm
relevant_laws.notes: The grounded intersection follow cell names a fire apparatus. Traveling alarm response, stopped answer to alarm, and subject emergency authorization/official business remain separately sourced premises. There are no accepted C109514 recordings.
